findings.issue: Dark mode CSS only uses @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) but no .dark class selector
findings.impact: ThemeProvider applies .dark class on manual toggle, but CSS never matches it. Manual light/dark selection is completely broken - app always follows OS preference.
findings.fix: Add .dark and :root:not(.light) selectors alongside the media query to support class-based theme switching

findings.issue: Thread replies lack edit, delete, and reaction support
findings.impact: Users cannot edit or delete their thread replies, and cannot react to thread replies. Major UX gap compared to primary message thread.
findings.fix: Add edit/delete actions (same pattern as message-list.tsx) and reaction support to thread panel

findings.impact: Users cannot see who is currently online. Only an aggregate 'N online' count is shown in the channel header.
findings.fix: Implement per-user green dot indicators next to user names in message list and member panels

findings.issue: No member list or member management UI in frontend
findings.impact: Users cannot view workspace/channel members, see roles, or invite/remove members from the UI.
findings.fix: Create a members page and member management components

findings.issue: No profile editing beyond avatar upload
findings.impact: Users cannot change display name, status, or bio. Display name is auto-generated from email prefix.
findings.fix: Add profile editing modal/page with display name, status message, and bio fields

findings.issue: Dialog and sidebar-group use raw Unicode icons instead of lucide-react icons
findings.impact: Inconsistent visual style - most of the app uses lucide-react icons, but dialog close is '✕' and sidebar-group chevron is '▸'.
findings.fix: Replace Unicode icons with lucide-react X and ChevronRight components
